actual: It IS a genuine class_feature (Ranger's own alternate combat-style-feat-chain choice granted by the Sentinel archetype at 10th level) -- structurally identical to ~180 correctly-Kind::ClassFeature RangerBonusFeat sibling records (e.g. advanced_players_guide/class_feature/ranger_combat_style_feat/vital_strike.json, the wave35 receipt's own cited analogy, which IS filed as class_feature). It is stuck in D because class_feature_owner's group-text match collides with an unrelated, genuinely-unmodelled corpus Kind::Class record literally named Sentinel (inner_sea_gods:class:sentinel, a prestige class) -- the same short-word-collision shape as Order of the Dragon (case a), not a Kind bug. Even a correct owner-attribution fix would not close it: magnitude_token_count=1 (not zero-magnitude, so the text-only promotion path does not apply) and the underlying mechanism (Ranger's own combat-style bonus-feat chain) is itself unbuilt engine-wide, proven by its 151 other D-bucket siblings under class_feature_owner_matched_by_name_but_record_not_held_by_engine. No ingest-time Kind change made -- it would corrupt a correctly-classified record and contradict the corpus's own established convention.
